title: Partial derivatives commute with coefficient maps
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to R'$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $n\ge0$, and $\kappa:R[x_1,\dots,x_n]\to R'[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] the ring homomorphism applying $\varphi$ to the coefficients ($\kappa(\sum_\alpha c_\alpha x^\alpha)=\sum_\alpha\varphi(c_\alpha)x^\alpha$). Then for every $f\in R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ and $i=1,\dots,n$ the formal partial derivatives [def-weil-pbc-polynomial-partial-derivative] satisfy $\partial\kappa(f)/\partial x_i=\kappa(\partial f/\partial x_i)$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma 07CC (lemma-strictly-standard-base-change, line 295), proof ('the result follows from the definitions'): implicit; from the monomial formula of the formal partial derivative, coefficientwise
